before: Liquid component molar delivery is C × Q. In a fully liquid-filled, unpacked reactor, V/QL is nominal liquid space time. Gas molar delivery uses the stated reference temperature and pressure; reactive-gas equivalents additionally include the active mole fraction. The inlet-reference index V/(QL + Qg,STP) is a bookkeeping index, not a physical residence time under operating pressure. Ideal-gas scaling gives Qg,ch = Qg,STP(Tch/TSTP)(PSTP/Pabs), with absolute temperature and pressure.
